entities.summary: Gustavo Adolfo Luiz Dodt da Cunha Barroso was a Brazilian lawyer, historian, writer and politician associated with Brazilian Integralism. He was also known by the pseudonym João do Norte. Being considered a master of Brazilian folklore, he was the first director of the National Historical Museum and one of the leaders of the Brazilian Integralist Action, being one of its most prominent ideologists. Gustavo Barroso was a political leaders from Fortaleza (1888-12-29, Fortaleza–1959-12-03). Holds notable historical significance, documented across 0 language editions of Wikipedia. Relevant to political systems and geopolitics.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Gustavo Barroso's leadership in Brazilian Integralism and his role as director of the National Historical Museum had a significant impact on Brazil's cultural identity and historical narrative. His work continues to be studied by scholars today.
